coverage.non_warrant_content: P004 supplies a preparatory inventory of worker versions, trace coverage, active work, initial queue depth, and available workload descriptors. It states no separate rationale or outcome relation. The role assignments, capability assumptions and gaps, workload boundary, and conditional deployment decisions in the remaining state spans are captured as claims.

Routine protocol includes verifying timestamps in P007; recording the baseline and step time in P009; allowing active work to finish and recording realized concurrency in P011; holding worker version and other controllable settings fixed in P012; retaining an unchanged comparison pool with comparable scheduled work where feasible and recording resource exposure and workload differences in P013; recording the transition and observation window in P014; and monitoring recovery in P016. P015's threshold categories substantively define the extracted safety conditions. P017's completion follow-up remains qualified by feasibility. No additional causal rationale is inferred from these procedural instructions.

The measurement commands in P018–P021 provide the operational collection procedure around the extracted temporal, cohort, tail, and unfinished-export distinctions. P020 also specifies organizing cohorts by queue-entry time and step exposure. P022 directs comparison with baseline and any unchanged pool without asserting that such a pool exists or giving a separate inferential conclusion. P024's recording rationale and P025's explicit proposed-versus-obtained distinction are extracted.

All material conditional interpretations, deployment consequences, and inferential restrictions in P026–P032 are represented. Pronouns and references to the tested setting provide connective context. The alternatives in P031 remain a single disjunctive next-action relation. No outcome is treated as already observed, and no numerical decision criteria are supplied.

All material propositions in P033–P040 are represented, including the reported rate, evidence-planning basis, safety restriction, independently stated potential distortions, realization delay, comparison contamination, nonlinear response dependence, settling prerequisites, null-result limitations, and applicability boundary. C062 records the general scope restriction on the experimental conclusions.

anomalies.detail: P028 calls reduced capacity a better explanation but does not explicitly identify the comparative alternative. The annotation preserves that comparative claim without supplying an unstated alternative.

P028 prohibits expansion of the lower limit under the stated response pattern, but does not specify the dimension of expansion. The existing span supports the ambiguous restriction; it does not resolve a specific numerical or deployment-scope interpretation.
